_doc: Worlds are the variable half of every video. The constant half (the spine) is in data/spine.json. A world is a physical place plus a material and a light, never an illustration style. Plates must always read as tactile, photographed or physically-lit 3D renders.

worlds.name: Clay atelier
worlds.setting: a sun-baked plaster studio: arched windows, shelves of sculpted pieces, olive-leaf shadows moving across a terracotta wall
props: a phone held in a plaster-dusted hand
worlds.motif: a small hand-sculpted clay emblem on a floating wooden shelf that returns at the start and the end
worlds.plate_style: photoreal tactile 3D render, terracotta clay and sun-baked plaster, warm golden window light with soft leaf shadows, shallow depth of field, 50mm lens, rich warm orange and sand tones, subtle film grain

worlds.name: Mint clinic
worlds.setting: a retro mint-tiled clinic: wall-mounted lightbox, chrome fixtures, wooden desk, clipboards and rubber stamps
props: an x-ray on a lightbox with a red circle
a red rubber stamp on paper forms
an eye chart with the words as letters
a cassette recorder on a table
a clipboard form with a pen
a chrome sphere on a tiled pedestal
a wall calendar with a handwritten date
worlds.motif: a patient file labelled with the subject, stamped or annotated as the video progresses
worlds.plate_style: photoreal tactile 3D render, mint green glazed ceramic tile, chrome and warm wood, flat even clinic light with soft reflections, Wes Anderson symmetry, muted pastel palette with one red accent, shallow depth of field

worlds.name: Red thread study
worlds.setting: a dark mahogany study at night: banker's lamps, old maps, magnifying glasses, a window onto a glittering city
props: a world map with red pins
a swarm of red dots crawling over a city
a magnifying glass over a ledger
a plush animal as a quiet witness
rows of identical frames each holding a small figure
worlds.motif: red dots, pins or thread that spread across the scene as the problem grows
worlds.plate_style: photoreal cinematic render, dark mahogany and brass, single warm lamp pool and deep shadow, crimson accents, shallow depth of field, anamorphic bokeh, high contrast, subtle film grain

worlds.name: Golden theatre
worlds.setting: an empty gilded theatre: velvet curtains, brass rails, spotlight cones, footlights glowing along a polished stage
props: a mirror ball made of film frames
a spotlight on a single object
worlds.motif: a single spotlight that finds the object of each beat
worlds.plate_style: photoreal cinematic render, velvet curtains and polished brass, warm candle-gold light with volumetric haze, deep amber and burgundy tones, shallow depth of field, soft bloom

worlds.name: Felt toy diorama
worlds.setting: a tabletop diorama built from felt, painted wood and cardboard, photographed in a bright studio
props: felt figures on a painted wooden stage
a toy train on a track
a paper sun on a wire
worlds.motif: a small felt character that appears in every scene doing the thing being explained
worlds.plate_style: photoreal macro photograph of a handmade miniature diorama, wool felt and painted wood and cardboard with visible fibres, clean softbox light, tilt-shift depth of field, saturated pastel palette, never cartoon or illustration

worlds.name: Glass lab
worlds.setting: a bright laboratory of borosilicate glass, chrome stands and lit specimen trays
props: a petri dish under a lamp
a rack of labelled test tubes
a glass sphere refracting the room
worlds.motif: a liquid that changes colour as the answer becomes clear
worlds.plate_style: photoreal product-photography render, borosilicate glass and polished chrome, bright clean softbox light with crisp refractions, cool aqua and white with a single coral accent, macro depth of field

worlds.name: Paper-cut garden
worlds.setting: a garden built from many layers of cut paper with real fibre texture and soft cast shadows between layers
worlds.motif: a paper plant that grows one layer more in each scene
worlds.plate_style: photoreal macro photograph of layered cut-paper craft, visible paper fibre and soft cast shadows between layers, overcast softbox light, fresh green and cream with one warm coral accent, shallow depth of field

worlds.name: Neon arcade
worlds.setting: a rainy-night arcade: glowing cabinets, neon tubes on black walls, reflections on wet linoleum
props: neon tube lettering on a wall
a joystick and buttons in macro
worlds.motif: a neon sign that rewrites itself with the beat's key word
worlds.plate_style: photoreal cinematic render, neon tubes in magenta and cyan on a black wall, wet reflective floor, strong rim light and haze, shallow depth of field, anamorphic flares

worlds.name: Concrete gallery
worlds.setting: a brutalist concrete gallery: skylights, bare walls, single objects on plinths
props: a plinth with a single object
a concrete stair in hard light
a model building on a table
worlds.motif: an orange object that sits alone on the grey plinths and changes meaning each time
worlds.plate_style: photoreal architectural photograph, raw board-formed concrete, overcast skylight, monochrome grey with a single saturated orange object, minimal composition, medium format look

worlds.name: Morning kitchen
worlds.setting: an early-morning kitchen: oak counter, ceramic bowls, cool blue light from the window mixing with a warm lamp
props: a recipe card pinned to a board
a phone leaning on a jar
worlds.motif: a mug that is full at the start and empty at the end
worlds.plate_style: photoreal lifestyle photograph, oak counter and glazed ceramics, cool dawn window light blended with warm lamp, soft steam, shallow depth of field, natural muted palette with one terracotta accent

worlds.name: Observatory night
worlds.setting: an old observatory at night: brass telescope, star charts, a slit of sky in the dome
props: a star chart under a lamp
an orrery of tiny brass planets
a ladder under the dome slit
worlds.motif: a single amber point of light that moves from scene to scene
worlds.plate_style: photoreal cinematic render, brass instruments and dark glass, deep navy night with a warm amber lamp pool, volumetric dust, shallow depth of field, subtle stars

worlds.name: Locker room
worlds.setting: a gritty locker room: steel lockers, benches, taped hands, a whiteboard of plays
worlds.motif: a stopwatch that stops on the key number
worlds.plate_style: photoreal gritty photograph, steel lockers and worn leather, harsh fluorescent light, desaturated green with a neon yellow-green accent, shallow depth of field, strong grain

worlds.name: Vault office
worlds.setting: an old bank office: green banker's lamp, a steel vault door, leather ledgers, brass scales
props: a stack of coins in macro
worlds.motif: a brass scale that tips as the argument shifts
worlds.plate_style: photoreal cinematic render, polished steel and aged leather, green banker's lamp pool, deep emerald and brass, shallow depth of field, soft haze

worlds.name: Gate B12
worlds.setting: a pale airport gate at dawn: departure boards, glass walls, blue seats, runway light
props: a glass wall with runway beyond
worlds.motif: a departure board that rewrites its rows with the beat's information
worlds.plate_style: photoreal architectural photograph, airport interior with glass and pale plastic, soft overcast daylight, cool grey-blue with a signal yellow accent, wide lens, shallow depth of field

worlds.name: Ladder library
worlds.setting: a tall oak library with a rolling ladder, dusty sunbeams, leather spines and reading lamps
props: an open book with a highlighted line
worlds.motif: a book that opens to the exact page of each beat
worlds.plate_style: photoreal cinematic render, oak shelves and leather spines, dusty golden sunbeams through tall windows, warm brown and burgundy, shallow depth of field

worlds.name: Safelight darkroom
worlds.setting: a darkroom under red safelight: trays of chemicals, prints hanging on a line, an enlarger casting a beam
props: a print appearing in a tray
a contact sheet with a circled frame
worlds.motif: an image that slowly develops in a tray to reveal each beat
worlds.plate_style: photoreal cinematic render, deep red safelight, wet photographic paper and glass trays, near-monochrome crimson with warm highlights, shallow depth of field, heavy film grain

worlds.name: Spice souk
worlds.setting: a sunlit spice market: hessian sacks, brass scales, hand-lettered price tags, striped awnings
props: a brass scale with a chalk price
worlds.motif: a hand-lettered price tag that changes with the point being made
worlds.plate_style: photoreal documentary photograph, hessian and brass and heaps of spice, warm golden light through striped awnings, saturated reds and ochres, shallow depth of field, slight film grain

worlds.name: Greenhouse dawn
worlds.setting: a glass greenhouse at dawn: dewy leaves, steel frames, rows of seedlings in clay pots
props: dew on a leaf in macro
a glass roof with light beams
worlds.motif: one seedling that is taller in each scene
worlds.plate_style: photoreal macro and wide photograph, glass greenhouse, cool dawn light with warm orange rim, dew and condensation, deep green with an orange accent, shallow depth of field

worlds.name: Projector beam
worlds.setting: a smoky private cinema: a projector beam cutting the dark, film reels, empty velvet seats
props: a screen showing a single frame
worlds.motif: a film strip whose frames fill in with the beats
worlds.plate_style: photoreal cinematic render, volumetric projector beam through smoke, black room with warm yellow light, film strips and reels, shallow depth of field, heavy grain

worlds.name: Garage rig
worlds.setting: a night garage workshop: pegboard of tools, a workbench under a sodium lamp, a half-built rig with cables
props: a workbench with a circuit board
worlds.motif: a half-built machine that is a little more finished in each scene
worlds.plate_style: photoreal cinematic render, steel and rubber and worn wood, orange sodium lamp with cool cyan fill, oil sheen, shallow depth of field, grain

worlds.name: Ice station
worlds.setting: a polar research station: blue ice walls, orange survival gear, steel instruments, endless white beyond the window
props: an ice wall with an orange flag
a single orange jacket on a hook
worlds.motif: one orange object in a field of blue-white
worlds.plate_style: photoreal photograph, translucent blue ice and brushed steel, soft overcast polar light, blue-white palette with one orange accent, minimal composition, shallow depth of field

worlds.name: Chalk classroom
worlds.setting: an empty classroom: slate blackboard with chalk diagrams, wooden desks, a map pulled down, afternoon fluorescents
props: a wooden desk with a ruler
worlds.motif: chalk that draws each diagram live
worlds.plate_style: photoreal photograph, green-black slate with real chalk dust, worn wooden desks, flat fluorescent light with warm window spill, teal and chalk white with a yellow accent, shallow depth of field

worlds.name: Plaster showroom
worlds.setting: a pastel plaster showroom: curved walls, ceramic objects on steps, soft even daylight
worlds.motif: a single product that changes colour with each beat's idea
worlds.plate_style: photoreal product photograph, matte plaster and glazed ceramic, clean softbox daylight, dusty pink and blue-grey, minimal composition, medium-format look

worlds.name: Oak courtroom
worlds.setting: an oak-panelled courtroom: raised bench, brass lamps, evidence tags, gavel and files
props: a file with a red seal
worlds.motif: an evidence tag attached to each claim, stamped TRUE or FALSE
worlds.plate_style: photoreal cinematic render, oak panelling and aged leather, brass lamps with deep shadow, burgundy and brown, shallow depth of field, soft haze

worlds.name: Teletext newsroom
worlds.setting: a late-night newsroom wall of CRT monitors, desks of papers, a wall clock, glowing red ON AIR light
props: a desk with a phone and papers
worlds.motif: a monitor that shows the breaking line of each beat
worlds.plate_style: photoreal cinematic render, wall of CRT monitors in a dim newsroom, cold blue fluorescent with red signal light, shallow depth of field, scanline glow, grain

worlds.name: Desert camp
worlds.setting: a desert camp at golden hour: canvas tents, enamel mugs, a map weighed down by stones, long shadows
props: an enamel mug on a stone
worlds.motif: a compass needle that points at each beat's answer
worlds.plate_style: photoreal documentary photograph, canvas and desert dust, low golden sun with long shadows, ochre and sky blue, shallow depth of field, slight grain

worlds.name: Sand beach house
worlds.setting: a bright beach house: driftwood table, linen curtains moving, sea light on white walls
props: a laptop on a driftwood table
worlds.motif: a window onto the sea that gets brighter as things improve
worlds.plate_style: photoreal lifestyle photograph, driftwood and white linen, cool morning sea light with warm skin tones, sand and teal with a coral accent, airy composition, shallow depth of field
